episodes.synopsis: Gin finds a strange clock and accidentally breaks it, causing all time in the universe to come to a stop.
episodes.title: You Can Never Pause at the Perfect Time

episodes.synopsis: Odd Jobs continue to try and fix the Universal Clock, with little success.
episodes.title: Even a Matsui Stick Can't Handle Some Kinds of Dirt

episodes.synopsis: Yamazaki is on the verge of breaking down after staking out Odd Jobs' place for days on end. Tama offers some words of encouragement at just the right moment. Unfortunately, Yamazaki's new found affection for Tama soon turns into full-blown stalking. Concerned, the Shinsengumi send Okita to help fix things...
episodes.title: An Inspector's Love Begins With an Inspection

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - Tsukuyo attempts to give Seita history lessons, but he refuses to take it seriously. Gintoki attempts to help, but his version of events may not be very accurate.

Part 2 - Shinpachi runs into Gintoki whilst attempting to smuggle "Ho Love-ru" manga. The pair discuss how best to hide them from his sister.
episodes.title: Forget Dates, Remember People / You Can Hide Your Porn Mags, But You Can't Hide Your ***

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - Sacchan finds a new stalking spot in Odd Job's building, but witnesses some unexpected things as the gang go about their morning rituals!

Part 2 - Yamazaki is fed up with being labelled as boring at work and tries to get a ninja license.
episodes.title: A Mirror Provides a Frozen Reflection of Both Your Beautiful and Ugly Sides / Nobody Likes the Photo on Their License

episodes.synopsis: Gin is tricked into turning up to a reunion party with Katsura and Sakamoto. The two are unhappy with their lack of screen time and are determined to start a flashback arc, but they then get sidetracked trying to figure out the identity of a supposed fifth hero who supported them from the sidelines.
episodes.title: Arriving Late to a Reunion Makes it Hard to Enter

episodes.synopsis: Gin and co finally remember the phantom fifth member, Kurokono Tasuke. They also remember blowing him up by accident! Could it be that this reunion was arranged by Kurokono's vengeful spirit?
episodes.title: A Reunion Also Brings to the Surface Things You Don't Want to Remember

episodes.synopsis: Whilst buying his cigarettes, Hijikata is persuaded to take a lottery ticket someone left behind. Against all the odds, it's the jackpot winner! Hijikata becomes paranoid that somebody knows he has the ticket and then bumps into the last person he wants to see!
episodes.title: When Compared to Time in the Heavens, Fifty Years of Human Life Resembles Naught but Dreams and Lottery Tickets

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - Odd Jobs discuss ways to advertise themselves to attract new customers.

Part 2 - Now that the previous four Devas have retired, the new leaders try to think of ways to make the Kabuki District less intimidating after being ranked the "least desirable place to live".
episodes.title: Guys With Big Nostrils Also Have Big Imaginations / You Never Accept a New Sentai Series at the Start, But By the Final Episode, You Don't Want It to End

episodes.synopsis: Chaos ensues in the Kabuki district after a fanatical cult swaps everyone's genders around.
episodes.title: 9 + 1 = Yagyu Jyubei

episodes.synopsis: Odd Jobs and the Shinsengumi (F) team up to overthrow the cult, but Kyubei starts to question whether he/she wants to turn back into a woman.
episodes.title: Calories Come Back to Bite You Just When You've Forgotten About Them

episodes.synopsis: The gang break into the cult's headquarters but the leaders have already escaped. Faced with the possibility of never changing back, everyone must now adjust to their new genders.

Concerned that Seita doesn't seem to be making friends at temple school, Hinowa and Tsukuyo, believing the problem to lie with his lunch box, attempt to fix the problem but only seem to make it worse.
episodes.title: All Mothers Pack Too Much Food Into a Lunch Box and Ruin the Shape

episodes.synopsis: Recently, there has been a bizarre string of murders around town. The victims have all been killed the same way, with their heads virtually severed, bar a small strand of flesh. Gintoki, whilst stumbling home drunk, encounters what appears to be a reaper who asks him to help with their ritual suicide. He will soon discover just how the two are related.
episodes.title: The Reaper by Day and the Reaper by Night

episodes.synopsis: After revealing that his name was among the criminals sentenced to be executed, Yaemon blackmails Gin into smuggling Asaemon to safety. Meanwhile, Hijikata and Okita follow up their own leads on the reaper, uncovering a greater conspiracy in the process.
episodes.title: Human or Demon?

episodes.synopsis: Asaemon confronts Yaemon, but after he reveals that it was Gintoki who was the reason for her father's death, her resolve waivers. Will her blade strike Yaemon or Gintoki?
episodes.title: Farewell, Reaper

episodes.synopsis: Hasegawa come to Odd Jobs looking for new ghost stories to scare kids in the park. Unfortunately, the scariest thing about these stories might be the copyright laws they're breaking!
episodes.title: A Phoenix Rises from the Ashes  Over and Over

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki notices that many drunken patrons of Otose's bar are confessing their sins to Tama and decides to take advantage of that by opening a confessional and taking a cut of the fees. Many of the confessions seem to mention a certain worthless boss who sounds very familiar!
episodes.title: Amen

episodes.synopsis: After the previous episode's escapades, Katsura finds the unconscious Shigeshige and takes him back to the Joi Rebels hideout. Shigeshige has lost his memories of being the Shogun, but everyone but Katsura recognizes him straight away! Katsura, seeing potential in Shigeshige as a natural-born leader, attempts to teach him the qualities of leadership, but ends up being one-upped by him!
episodes.title: Being a Leader is Tough

episodes.synopsis: After inviting Otae to the festival and being rejected, Kondo rampages around, taking his frustrations out on happy couples there. In an effort to hide the fact that the one making the scene is the Shinsengumi chief, Sougo and Hijikata convince him to wear a disguise. A short while later, Kondo runs into Otae, who doesn't seem to recognize him in his cockroach mask.
episodes.title: Love is a Roach Motel

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - After being told by Gin and Shinpachi that part of the joy of eating watermelons is the "drama" that comes with them, Kagura and Princess Soyo decide to raise the stakes.

Part 2 - Summer break is almost over and Seita has not done his homework! He goes to Odd Jobs for help but as usual gets more than he bargained for!
episodes.title: A Sizzle Summer / A Nothing Summer 2015

episodes.synopsis: After getting hit by a truck, Gin and Hijikata mysteriously switch bodies. Now they must adapt to living each other's lives while trying to find a way to switch back.
episodes.title: He's the Sweet Tooth, and I'm the Mayo Guy

episodes.synopsis: Gin and Hijikata find Gengai, who's newest invention is responsible for their body swapping. He tries to reverse the process but it doesn't work as something is missing. Gin remembers that part of his soul ended up in a dead cat which they must now find. Unfortunately, the Shinsengumi, with their new found freedom, and Odd Jobs, with their new strict codes, seem intent on getting in their way.
episodes.title: I'm a Failure as a Leader, and He's Also a Failure as a Leader

episodes.synopsis: Gin and Hijikata manage to track down the cat with part of Gin's soul in it, which is being looked after by Otae. Attempts to capture it are complicated when the rest of the gang turn up and have also swapped bodies!
episodes.title: I'm Odd Jobs, and He's Shinsengumi

episodes.synopsis: Mutsu recalls to Gin how she and Sakamoto first became acquainted.
episodes.title: Always Leave Enough Room for Fifty Million in Your Bag

episodes.synopsis: Sakamoto has been kidnapped by the pirates they double-crossed in the past! Now, it's up to Mutsu and Gin to rescue him.
episodes.title: Always Leave Enough Room for Pebbles in Your Bag

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - The Odd Jobs trio try out different outfits and styles, with disastrous consequences. 

Part 2 - Facing a disinterested group of old bums at their Dojo, Shinpachi asks the others for help in motivating them. They discover a scroll left behind by his dad containing a secret ultimate move.
episodes.title: Style Goes Out of Fashion the Moment It's Put Into Words / There Are Two Types of People In This World: Those Who Yell Out Their Attack Names, and Those Who Don't

episodes.synopsis: Whilst out "patrolling" Tae's house, Kondo encounters a notorious thief known as Ape Boy. Sensing his Gorilla-like strength and agility, Ape Boy asks Kondo to become his disciple.
episodes.title: The Two Apes

episodes.synopsis: Katsura attempts to infiltrate the Shinsengumi wearing an afro as a disguise. He gets more than he bargained for when he is assigned to the squad of another Afro-wearer with some serious social issues!
episodes.title: Afros of Life and Death

episodes.synopsis: Zura, having successfully infiltrated the Shinsengumi, now attempts to get rid of Wolfro, deeming him a threat.
episodes.title: Afuro and Wolfro

episodes.synopsis: Whilst on a job tailing someone in the blistering summer heat, Gin steals Kagura's parasol, forgetting that the Yato are weak against sunlight. Kagura falls ill and is taken to the hospital.
episodes.title: Take the Initial Premise Lightly, and It'll Cost You

episodes.synopsis: Kagura's ruse has gone too far! After faking her illness things take a turn for the worse as everyone assumes she is dying. Even Soyo turns up and ends up planning a state funeral for her. It looks like it's too late for Kagura to correct the misunderstanding now!
episodes.title: Keep Your Farewells Short

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - After faking a stomachache to work on his Manga in peace in the infirmary, Shachi's work is discovered by the nurse there, who likes it a lot! Shachi wants to try asking her out but doesn't know how to. Gin suggests he do it through his Manga.

Part 2 - Gin and Shachi finally get a chance to debut in Jump, however they only have one night to finish their manuscript! Gin finds some assistants to help. Will they finish in time?
episodes.title: One Editor Is Enough / The G-Pen Is Capricious and the Maru Pen Is Stubborn

episodes.synopsis:
Part 1 - Tetsuko leaves Odd Jobs in charge of her store while she looks for rare materials. It doesn't take long before some strange characters appear asking for various legendary swords to be fixed.

Part 2 - Tama befriends an cigarette vending machine that has become unreliable due to its age. Over time, the two become closer, but their happy days may be numbered.
episodes.title: Strike When the Sword and Overlord are Hot / Oil Rain

episodes.synopsis: After the Shogun nearly falls victim to an assassination attempt by unknown forces, a plan is put into motion to help him escape Edo. Several diversions, each with body doubles set off in different directions, guarded by those loyal to Shigeshige. However the loyalty of some remains uncertain...
episodes.title: Shoguns of Light and Shadow

episodes.synopsis: Zenzou and the Iga clan have betrayed the Shogun! Their forces are ambushed from all sides as forces loyal to the shogun desperately fight back.
episodes.title: Ninja Village

episodes.synopsis: After it becomes clear that the Iga clan didn't actually betray the Shogun, Gin and co are taken to their village and learn the truth about the Shogun's deep involvement with the clan in the past.
episodes.title: Ninja Soul

episodes.synopsis: As Sarutobi attempts to rescue the critically wounded Zenzou, Odd Jobs, Hijikata and Kondou desparately fight back against the ruthless Yato clan, trying to get the Shogun to safety. Meanwhile, Takasugi seeks out Gintoki to end things once and for all.
episodes.title: And Then There Were Five

episodes.synopsis: Past histories are finally confronted for Gintoki and Kagura as they face off against Takasugi and Kamui.
episodes.title: Those Who Protect Against All Odds

episodes.synopsis: As Gintoki and Takasugi continue their frenzied fight, the past they shared together with Katsura is revealed, as well as the fate of their teacher, Shouyou. This is also known as the greatest episode ever made.
episodes.title: Sworn Enemy

episodes.synopsis: As various conflicts draw to their conclusions, the Tendoshu swoop in to finish off the survivors.
episodes.title: The Crows Caw After the Battle Ends

episodes.synopsis: With the battle over, the survivors each go their separate ways. With Nobunobu appointed the new Shogun, Shigeshige and his retainers retreat to Kyo to regroup. For those left in Edo, there may be dark times ahead.
episodes.title: Farewell, Buddy

episodes.synopsis: Following Shigeshige's assassination, the new Shogun, Nobunobu begins a purge of the old guard. Matsudaira and Kondo are blamed for failing to prevent the assassination and sentenced to be beheaded and the Shingengumi are disbanded. Lost and without a leader, they must now decide what to do next.
episodes.title: The Day the Demon Cried

episodes.synopsis: Gin and Hijikata are drinking away their sorrows when Nobunobu and the Mimawarigumi storm the place. Nobunobu, not satisfied with having crushed Shigeshige and thei Shinsengumi attempts to antagonize Hijikata. Suddenly, an unexpected ally arrives.
episodes.title: Heroes Always Arrive Fashionably Late

episodes.synopsis: Whilst Kondo And Katsura attempt to break out of prison, Hijikata must decide which path to walk.
episodes.title: Lost and Found

episodes.synopsis: The Shinsengumi and Joi Rebels team up to rescue Kondo and Katsura from the prison island known as Kokujo, but things do not go to plan and they are soon ambushed by a familiar enemy.
episodes.title: Prison Break

episodes.synopsis: Odd Jobs and the Shinsengumi make land on the prison island, but to reach Kondo and Katsura they must content with the Tendoshu and the Mimawarigumi first.
episodes.title: Stray Dogs

episodes.synopsis: Sasaki Isaburo's past with the Shinsengumi, Matsudaira, and Imai Nobume is finally revealed.
episodes.title: Undelivered Mail

episodes.synopsis: Things come to a head on Kokujo Island, as death itself descends upon the battlefield.
episodes.title: Karma

episodes.synopsis: With everyone fighting to regroup and escape, Sasaki makes the same mistake one more time.
episodes.title: Nobume

episodes.synopsis: The complete fallout of the events at Kokujo Island come to light and brings about farewells nobody thought they'd ever see.
episodes.title: Farewell Shinsengumi
